disclaimer: Editorial compilation of public operator announcements and reputable trade reporting. Coordinates are city or county reference points, NOT surveyed facility locations. Announced capacity is planned, not commissioned. This dataset does not establish where inference is served.

sites.name: Stargate I — Abilene campus
sites.operator: Crusoe (developer) / Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (operator) for OpenAI
sites.capacity_note: First two buildings operational (980,000 sq ft, 200MW+ IT load); planned campus ~1.2GW across eight buildings (Crusoe/DCD reporting).
sites.accelerator_note: NVIDIA GB200 racks delivered by Oracle; early training and inference workloads running (OpenAI announcement).
sites.notes: Coordinates are the city reference point for Abilene, TX, not a surveyed facility location. Official OpenAI announcement confirms the Abilene campus is up and running on OCI. Later trade reporting (DCD, Mar 2026) indicates the planned 2GW expansion was cancelled; the operational first phase is unaffected.

sites.name: Project Rainier — St. Joseph County campus
sites.capacity_note: Seven buildings online; ~500,000 Trainium2 chips reported at activation; full site planned >2.2GW across ~30 buildings (AWS/CNBC reporting).
sites.accelerator_note: AWS Trainium2 UltraServers (non-NVIDIA accelerators); EFA petabit-scale networking.
sites.notes: Coordinates are the New Carlisle, IN reference point. AWS states the cluster is operational and used to train and run Anthropic Claude models. Chip counts are operator-reported, not independently verified.

sites.name: Colossus — South Memphis
sites.capacity_note: 200,000 NVIDIA H100 GPUs in a single interconnected cluster (xAI); stated roadmap to 1 million GPUs.
sites.accelerator_note: NVIDIA H100 (Hopper) with Spectrum-X Ethernet networking (NVIDIA newsroom).
sites.notes: Coordinates are the Memphis, TN reference point. GPU counts are operator-reported. xAI describes the facility as supporting training of Grok-scale models.

sites.name: Stargate UAE — UAE–U.S. AI Campus
sites.capacity_note: 1GW Stargate UAE cluster within a planned 5GW campus; first 200MW expected to go live in 2026 (OpenAI/G42 announcements).
sites.accelerator_note: NVIDIA Grace Blackwell GB300 systems (G42 announcement).
sites.notes: Coordinates are the Abu Dhabi city reference point. Announced capacity is planned, not commissioned. Reuters (Sep 2026) reported the masterplan was under revision; status remains under_construction pending official confirmation.

sites.name: Stargate — Shackelford County
sites.capacity_note: Part of 4.5GW additional Oracle–OpenAI Stargate capacity; site-level capacity not separately disclosed.
sites.notes: Coordinates are the county centroid reference point, not a facility location. Announced site; no commissioning date confirmed in the source.

sites.name: Stargate — Doña Ana County
sites.capacity_note: Part of the five-site Stargate expansion (~7GW planned total across the programme).
sites.notes: County centroid reference point. Announced, not commissioned.

sites.name: Stargate — Lordstown, Ohio
sites.capacity_note: SoftBank site able to scale to 1.5GW over 18 months together with the Milam County site; ground broken per OpenAI announcement.
sites.notes: City reference point. OpenAI states SoftBank has broken ground and the site is on track to be operational the following year; not yet commissioned.

sites.name: Stargate — Milam County, Texas
sites.capacity_note: Powered-infrastructure fast-build site; part of the SoftBank 1.5GW scalable pairing.
sites.notes: County centroid reference point. Announced, not commissioned.

sites.name: Loughton AI data centre (Nscale)
sites.capacity_note: 50MW AI/HPC capacity planned, total power allocation up to 90MW; initially 23,040 NVIDIA GPUs reported.
sites.notes: City reference point. Microsoft withdrew as anchor tenant (DCD, Oct 2026); grid connection reportedly not expected until the 2030s. Nscale states it remains committed to the project. Status is announced/planned, NOT operational. Source is trade press, not an operator announcement.
